title: Subhanallah
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah

title: Alhamdulillah
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: All praise is for Allah

title: Allahu Akbar
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest

title: La ilaha illallah
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
translation: There is no god but Allah

title: Astaghfirullah
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah

title: Salawat
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious

title: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Glory and praise be to Allah

title: Subhanallahil Azeem
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Glory and praise be to Allah; Glory be to Allah the Magnificent

title: Hawqala
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

title: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs

title: Complete Tahlil
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things competent

title: Full Istighfar
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'Azeemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal-Hayyal-Qayyooma wa atoobu ilayh
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him

title: Salawat Ibrahimiyyah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious

title: Rabbighfir li
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
translation: My Lord, forgive me

title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu bi-rahmatika astagheeth
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help

title: After Salah set
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ · الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ · اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Glory / Praise / Greatest — the classic after-prayer dhikr set

title: Morning 100
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Recommended 100 times in the morning

title: Evening 100
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Recommended 100 times in the evening

title: La hawla 100
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil-'Aliyyil-'Azeem
translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent

title: Bismillah
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

title: Protection from Fire
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire

title: Raditu billahi Rabba
arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Radeetu billaahi Rabbaa, wa bil-Islaami deenaa, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyaa
translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as Prophet

title: Dua of Yunus
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minazh-zhaalimeen
translation: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed I have been of the wrongdoers

title: Kalima Tayyiba
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
translation: There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
